## What we learned

Technical work starts with communication.

- A **name tag** has a need: another person has to be able to identify you.
- The **About Me** activity practised deciding what information is useful to communicate.
- **Listening notes** practised learning from other people rather than waiting to speak.
- **Technical description** moved from personal communication toward describing objects and systems clearly.
- **Machine Charades** used movement and teamwork to communicate a machine or process without relying on a long explanation.
